title: Multiple crashes along U.S 231 raise safety concerns - NewsBreak
text:
By Lanie Gatson, Star City News ,
10 hours ago After several serious crashes lately on U.S 231, some drivers are raising concerns about the long, busy roadway. Law enforcement shared what drivers should keep in mind. "To start with, we would ask everybody to obey the speed limits. Travel at the posted speed limit is," said Tippecanoe County Chief Deputy Terry Ruley. "Yesterday's crash at U.S 231 and Veterans Memorial Parkway, that was an incident where we believe that it was a failure to yield contributing circumstance." Read full article
